body.x: AURASENS presented a sensational smart chair at 'CES 2018 Unveiled' in 7th of January in Las Vegas, United States.

Inspired by the Japanese origami art and added to its comfort, AURASENSE will provide users with the pleasure of audio Haptic. The tablets on the chair also let users listen to a variety of tracks that are updated every month.

AURASENSE’ Smart Chair with Vibration Haptic Configuration (VHC) that stimulates the touch through vibrations is designed to change the patterns of vibrations according to the style of music. For instance, when users listen to club music, they can experience a rhythmic vibration from head to toe as if you were in a club.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
